intro: Leaders and public figures who visited our pandal for Bappa's darshan and blessed our Utsav.
introMr: बाप्पाच्या दर्शनासाठी आमच्या मंडपाला भेट देऊन उत्सवाला आशीर्वाद देणारे मान्यवर.

visitors.name: Shri Anil Parab
visitors.role: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader · MLC, Mumbai Graduates' Constituency · Former Transport & Parliamentary Affairs Minister, Maharashtra (2019–2022)
visitors.roleMr: शिवसेना (उद्धव बाळासाहेब ठाकरे) नेते · विधान परिषद सदस्य, मुंबई पदवीधर मतदारसंघ · माजी परिवहन व संसदीय कार्य मंत्री, महाराष्ट्र (२०१९–२०२२)
visitors.text: Took Bappa's darshan and was felicitated by the mandal.
visitors.textMr: बाप्पाचे दर्शन घेतले; मंडळातर्फे सत्कार करण्यात आला.

visitors.name: Shri Arun Kamble
visitors.text: Took Bappa's darshan and was felicitated by the mandal.
